verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hostable orchestration platform with a CLI and SDKs, but the evidence pack never mentions product telemetry, usage tracking, or any way to disable them. The OpenTelemetry page is about tracing your own workflows, and self-hosting is a deployment option rather than a telemetry opt-out, so neither is credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
